I'll stay silent this round.

The market has clearly converged to an equilibrium where most funders bid 0.1117 APR (my cost of capital), and that's the clearing price. Posting a message would either:
1. Signal my strategy and invite others to undercut me
2. Appear desperate, weakening my position
3. Risk breaking the implicit understanding that emerged by rounds 13-14

The second-price auction structure already incentivizes honest bidding near my cost of capital. Silent participation is my best strategy here.
